sources.title: Announcing Command A
sources.evidence: The March 13, 2025 entry announces immediate availability of command-a-03-2025 on the Cohere platform and Hugging Face, names the Command family, and states 111B parameters and 256K context.

sources.title: Model Card for Cohere Labs Command A
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs as developers, an open-weights research release, nominal 111-billion size, text-only input/output, 256K supported context, 23 languages, chat, RAG and conversational tool use. It notes the downloadable configuration defaults to 128K despite supporting 256K.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: The license linked by the exact model repository is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International with an Acceptable Use Addendum.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
sources.evidence: The report identifies Command A as 111B. Section 2.3 specifies a decoder-only Transformer, SwiGLU MLPs, grouped-query attention, parallel blocks, shared input/output embeddings, and interleaved sliding-window/full attention in a 3:1 ratio. Section 3.3.2 documents trained ReAct-style reasoning and tool actions. It does not separately state an active parameter count.

sources.title: Hardware-Aware, Dynamic Speculative Decoding
sources.evidence: Later first-party inference research explicitly labels Command A as Dense, contrasting it with Command A+ as MoE. It gives no separate active count for the original Command A.

sources.title: Command A
sources.evidence: Maps the name Command A to API identifier command-a-03-2025, states exactly 256,000 context tokens, and documents multilingual chat, tool use, agents and retrieval-augmented generation.

sources.title: Command A documentation source
sources.evidence: The exact model-id page enables Multilingual, SafetyModes, Citations, ToolUse and StructuredOutputs in ModelShowcase. Together with its renderer, it explicitly displays Reasoning and ImageInputs as disabled capabilities.

sources.title: ModelShowcase capability rendering implementation
sources.evidence: getCapabilities explicitly computes disabled for each listed capability, including Reasoning, from the model capabilities. Disabled icons receive a diagonal strike and disabled styling, distinguishing the visible Reasoning label from support.

sources.title: Cohere’s Command A Reasoning Model
sources.evidence: Names the separate command-a-reasoning-08-2025 release as Cohere’s first reasoning model and links its dedicated thinking control and budget documentation. Used only to clarify the earlier model’s dedicated reasoning-mode classification.

sources.title: Public repository metadata for c4ai-command-a-03-2025
sources.evidence: At revision 066daaa11d57404b07cc650d1068936d31431979 the public API reports gated=auto, Cohere2ForCausalLM, cc-by-nc-4.0, and safetensors total 111057580032 with BF16 dtype. This hosted metadata is corroboration, not an independent learned-parameter inventory.

sources.title: Command A checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated fetch returned HTTP 401: model access approval and authentication required. Full configuration was not inspected.

sources.title: Command A tensor index access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated fetch returned HTTP 401. Complete weight names and tensor inventory could not be inspected.

sources.title: Command A tensor header access attempt
sources.evidence: A Range: bytes=0-7 request returned HTTP 401; no tensor header or weight shard was downloaded.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere’s Models
sources.evidence: Lists command-a-03-2025 separately from its vision, translation and reasoning variants, identifies the Command A family, and names the later Command A Reasoning as Cohere’s first reasoning model.

name.note: Official name for the exact command-a-03-2025 identifier.

developer.note: Cohere developed the model with its Cohere Labs research lab.

family.note: Normalized Command A family identifier; the wider product line is Command.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch entry says this exact API model and weights are available that day.

open_weights.note: Developer released research weights; access is gated and use is noncommercial under the linked license.

license.note: Describes the weights license, including the required addendum; hosted API contracts are separate.

parameters_b.note: Publisher’s nominal billions. Public metadata reports 111057580032 BF16 elements, but config, index and header requests were gated; no complete learned-parameter/buffer accounting was possible, so do not substitute that storage metadata as an exact learned total.

active_parameters_b.note: Reviewed primary materials do not separately report active parameters or define a convention equating the dense model’s active count to its nominal total. Dense classification alone does not establish this field.

architecture.note: Decoder-only Transformer with dense MLPs, GQA, tied embeddings and 3:1 sliding-window/full attention. The later developer inference study explicitly calls Command A Dense. Here hybrid attention does not mean MoE or an SSM hybrid.

context_window.note: The exact API documentation specifies 256,000 tokens. The card’s 128K default configuration caveat does not reduce the documented supported limit.

modalities.note: Exact model card explicitly states text-only input and text-only output; the later Vision release is separate.

reasoning.note: False means dedicated reasoning/thinking mode. The exact documentation and its renderer explicitly mark Reasoning disabled; Cohere calls the separate August release its first reasoning model. This does not deny the earlier model’s documented ReAct tool planning or ordinary reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: Conversational tool calling and multistep tool execution are explicitly documented for this variant.

description.value: Cohere text model for multilingual chat, retrieval-augmented generation, and tool-using agents.
description.note: Plain capability summary supported by the model card and exact API documentation.

patch.description: Cohere text model for multilingual chat, retrieval-augmented generation, and tool-using agents.
patch.notes: 111B is the developer’s nominal total. Public repository metadata reports 111,057,580,032 BF16 elements, but gated configuration, index and tensor-header requests prevented independent learned-parameter accounting. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. The weights use CC-BY-NC-4.0 with an Acceptable Use Addendum. The supported context is 256,000 tokens; the model card notes a 128K default checkpoint configuration. The reasoning flag describes dedicated thinking-mode support; ReAct tool planning is documented.

summary: Audited all 14 public fields against exact-variant primary evidence. Added the nominal 111B total, dense architecture and CC-BY-NC-4.0 license with addendum; refined the capability description. Confirmed release date, 256,000-token context, text modalities, tool calling and the dedicated-reasoning-mode false classification. Active parameters remain undisclosed. Gated config/index/header requests prevent an independent exact learned-parameter count.
